68|27751eb6.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|27751eb6.text: Go to the Mage Quarter and seek out Fyrenz Stargazer, just northwest of the mage tower.

35-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
35-accept.text:
If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas.  He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

Bring me his report.
35-accept.title: Further Concerns

40-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
40-complete.text:
Yes, I spoke with Remy.  I respect him as a merchant, though all reports of Murlocs to the east have been sketchy at best.

Your concerns are noted, but unless I receive a military report of a murloc threat, we can't afford to send more troops east.
40-complete.title: A Fishy Peril

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-accept.name: William Pestle
61-accept.text:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
61-accept.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

85-accept.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
85-accept.text:
I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it!  He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here. 

Get my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
85-accept.title: Lost Necklace

85-complete.name: Billy Maclure
85-complete.text:
You lost a what?  Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!

I might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.
85-complete.title: Lost Necklace

86-accept.name: Billy Maclure
86-accept.text:
Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace.  And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies... 

Maybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
86-accept.title: Pie for Billy

88-accept.name: Ma Stonefield
88-accept.text:
The Brackwells have a prize-winning pig, Princess.  The sow is HUGE, and she got that way from sneaking over here and eating my veggies!

So before she comes to our fields...Princess must die!  Bring me her collar as proof of the deed and I'll give you something for your time!

Princess is usually over at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, to the east and beyond the Maclure farm.  Get her before she gets hungry and comes back here!
88-accept.title: Princess Must Die!

91777-complete.name: Brother Paxton
91777-complete.text: Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
91777-complete.title: Rare Books

91777-progress.name: Brother Paxton
91777-progress.text: Have you found all my missing books yet?
91777-progress.title: Rare Books

97917-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97917-accept.text:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97917-accept.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97920-accept.name: Sam Sarsaparilla
97920-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97920-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

99127-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99127-complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.
99127-complete.title: A Net Disaster

99128-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99128-accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
99128-accept.title: Slimy Menace

99128-complete.name: Jason Mathers
99128-complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
99128-complete.title: Slimy Menace

99129-accept.name: Jason Mathers
99129-accept.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
99129-accept.title: A Man About a Murloc

99129-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
99129-complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.
99129-complete.title: A Man About a Murloc

99130-accept.name: Remy "Two Times"
99130-accept.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.
99130-accept.title: An Enticing Offer

99143-complete.name: Lee Brown
99143-complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
99143-complete.title: Bottles and Baubles

99143-progress.name: Lee Brown
99143-progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
99143-progress.title: Bottles and Baubles
